groups.title: Vendor-Neutral Instrumentation
groups.question: Explain how you would instrument applications so their telemetry works no matter which cloud or vendor you use.

followUps.OpenTelemetry as the Multi-Cloud Observa: What is the cost of instrumenting code directly with a vendor SDK instead of OpenTelemetry?
followUps.OTel Collector Deployment for Multi-Clou: Why would you route per-cloud Collectors through a central gateway instead of sending data straight to the backend?

groups.title: Centralized Metrics at Scale
groups.question: Walk through how you would give engineers one place to query metrics from every cloud.

followUps.Thanos for Long-Term Multi-Cloud Prometh: How does Thanos give long-term retention and a global view on top of several Prometheus servers?
followUps.Grafana Mimir for Scalable Multi-Tenant: When would you choose Grafana Mimir over Thanos for a large multi-cloud setup?

groups.title: Unified Logging Across Clouds
groups.question: Explain how you would bring logs from all your clouds together for debugging and security.

followUps.Centralizing Logs from AWS, Azure, and G: Why does applying a common log schema at export time matter for cross-cloud investigations?
followUps.Grafana Loki for Multi-Cloud Log Aggrega: Why is Loki cheaper to run than a full-text search engine, and what do you give up for that?

groups.title: Cross-Cloud SLOs
groups.question: Explain how you would measure the reliability of a service that runs across more than one cloud.

followUps.Defining SLOs for Multi-Cloud Services: Why should a multi-cloud SLO be measured from the user side rather than per cloud?
followUps.Synthetic Monitoring Across Cloud Region: How do you keep synthetic monitors from paging on one-off network blips while still pinpointing the bad region?
